diagnosis: Run4 is the best scratch Transformer so far, but it remains fail-closed at verification recall@FAR10 0.7626 versus the 0.85 gate.
T=32 improved recall by 0.0310 over run3, but the remaining 0.0874 gap is too large to assume a T=40 representation-only run is the next smallest useful lever.
The next bottleneck is likely embedding separation/calibration for verification, not basic sequence capacity.
Teacher coverage is partial, so alpha/temperature tuning affects only the covered subset and is less direct than a verification-oriented auxiliary objective.
research_conclusion.selected_preflight: Implement and locally dry-run a training-only supervised contrastive auxiliary loss on the existing T=32 Transformer path with zero optimizer steps and no checkpoint writes.
research_conclusion.recommendation: Add disabled-by-default --supcon-weight and --supcon-temperature flags, expose a normalized training embedding from the Transformer, prove CE/KD behavior is unchanged at weight 0.0, and run one T=32 dry-run-forward receipt with finite supcon diagnostics before any paid run5.
research_conclusion.why_t40_waits: T=32 was useful, but its 0.0310 recall@FAR10 gain leaves nearly three times that gain still needed; T=40 requires new cache audit and more quadratic Transformer compute without evidence that temporal truncation is still the dominant error.
next_preflight_requirements: Add --supcon-weight float default 0.0 and --supcon-temperature float default 0.10.
Expose or return a normalized Transformer clip embedding for training diagnostics without changing runtime inference.
Compute supervised contrastive loss from same-label positives inside the batch, skip anchors with no positives, and report zero only when no positive anchors exist.
Preserve existing CE/KD semantics exactly when --supcon-weight 0.0.

Run a no-Brev dry-run-forward on .cache/recog-seq-w64-t32-merged-v1 with batch 128, logits [128,95], finite CE/KD and supcon components, positive-anchor count, optimizer steps 0, expected dry-run steps 0, planned paid-run steps 13200, and no checkpoint.

run5_recipe_if_preflight_passes.expected_change_vs_run4: Only add the training-only supervised contrastive auxiliary loss; keep T=32 cache and run4 optimizer/model/data recipe otherwise fixed.

paid_run5_kill_conditions: Abort before optimizer steps if the CUDA dry-run has wrong counts, wrong sequence length, wrong feature dimension, logits not [128,95], NaN/Inf loss components, optimizer steps in dry-run, or a checkpoint write during dry-run.
Kill if any loss becomes NaN/Inf, actual optimizer steps diverge from expected 13200, or class/split/sequence counts change after training begins.
Kill if monitor top-1 remains below 0.10 through epoch 20, below 0.25 through epoch 80, or below 0.33 through epoch 160.
Kill if supervised contrastive loss is always exactly 0.0 after multiple logged batches, indicating the auxiliary objective is inactive or no positive anchors are being used.
At completion, treat the run as fail-closed unless verification recall@FAR10 reaches 0.85; also treat it as not useful for promotion if it does not beat run4 recall 0.7626.
do_not_do_next: Do not combine multiple new levers in run5.
Do not add pretrained runtime dependencies.
Do not upload raw learner practice video.
Do not tune on the test set.
Do not promote browser/runtime artifacts unless recall@FAR10 reaches >= 0.85.
